description: Traffic Flow Data Jan to SDCC is a series of datasets listed in Ireland national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by South Dublin County Council. SDCC Traffic Congestion Saturation Flow Data for January to June 2022. Traffic volumes, traffic saturation, and congestion data for sites across South Dublin County. Used by traffic management to control stage timings on junctions. It is recommended that this dataset is read in conjunction with the ‘Traffic Data Site Names SDCC’ dataset. Coverage: South Dublin County Council. The portal lists 5 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher South Dublin County Council. Its tags are Congestion, Roads, Saturation, Transportation, Volumes. It offers 4 resource(s) in ARCGIS GEOSERVICES REST API, CSV, GEOJSON, HTML. The portal shows 2026-09-22 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ie-portal.
